'''''Chenopodium opulifolium''''', the '''seaport goosefoot''', is a species of annual herb in the family [[Amaranthaceae]] (pigweeds). They have a self-supporting growth form. They are associated with freshwater habitat and have simple, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 67 cm tall.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Chenopodium opulifolium Schrader - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/586725|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref name=POWO>{{cite web |url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:60447126-2 |title= Chenopodium opulifolium Schrad. ex W.D.J.Koch & Ziz |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=April 17, 2025}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{cite web |url= https://www.catalogueoflife.org/data/taxon/TXHJ |title= Chenopodium opulifolium Schrad. ex W.D.J.Koch & Ziz |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Catalogue of Life |publisher=Species 2000 |access-date=April 17, 2025}}</ref>
